ai-rulez.description: Xberg AI knowledge base: per-domain DOMAIN.md, agents, rules, and context docs (crate structure, MIME routing, WASM constraints, config precedence, feature flags). Use for authoritative behavior before guessing.

binding.description: Handles the Alef binding pipeline: regenerating Go/Java/C#/Node/Python/Ruby/PHP/WASM bindings, tracking freshness, applying rename mappings, and respecting no-ORT feature-flag constraints.

extraction.description: Rust core extraction-engine work: MIME detection, extractor routing, fallback chains, SecurityLimits, caching, new-format wiring in crates/xberg/src/core.

ocr.description: OCR integration work: Tesseract/Paddle/Candle/VLM backends, preprocessing, hOCR/table reconstruction, language registry, confidence in crates/xberg/src/ocr.

plugin.description: Plugin-system work: Extractor/PostProcessor/Validator traits, priority-based registry, Python PyO3 FFI, GIL management in crates/xberg/src/plugins.

xberg-dev.description: General Xberg developer helper: running task build/test/lint/coverage, alef regen + verify, version sync, and cross-cutting Rust/TS conventions.

build.description: Build the Xberg Rust core (and optionally bindings) via `task build*`.
build.template:
Build the Xberg Rust core (and optionally bindings):
!`task build`
Report any build errors and suggest fixes.

test.description: Run Xberg test suites via `task test*` / `task e2e*`.
test.template:
Run the Xberg test suite:
!`task test`
Summarize failures, if any, and suggest fixes.

lint.description: Lint and format the whole Xberg workspace via `task lint` / `task format` / `task check`.
lint.template:
Lint and check the whole Xberg workspace:
!`task lint`
Summarize any issues and suggest fixes.

alef.description: Regenerate or verify Alef-managed bindings (task alef:generate / alef:verify).
alef.template:
Verify Alef-managed bindings are up to date:
!`task alef:verify`
If bindings are stale, regenerate them with `task alef:generate` and summarize what changed.

e2e.description: Run end-to-end extraction tests across languages (task e2e:lang LANG=...).
e2e.template:
Run end-to-end extraction tests for language: $ARGUMENTS
!`task e2e:lang LANG=$ARGUMENTS`
Summarize failures, if any, and suggest fixes.
